title: Classic Canadian Macaroni Bake
description: A comforting, cheesy pasta bake that's perfect for a cold winter's night. This dish combines warm, comforting flavours with the familiarity of macaroni and cheese.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly add milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and mozzarella cheese until melted and smooth.
Add cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer macaroni and cheese to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with additional cheese and paprika (if using).
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
